```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
#### Basic Isosurface Plot

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_isosurface(
    x = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1),
    y = c(1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0),
    z = c(1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0),
    value = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8),
    isomin = 2,
    isomax = 6
  )

fig
```

#### Isosurface with Additional Slices

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/clebsch-cubic.csv")

fig <- df |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_isosurface(
    x = ~x,
    y = ~y,
    z = ~z,
    value = ~value,
    isomin = -100,
    isomax = 100,
    colorscale = "RdBu",
    surface = go_isosurface_surface(show = TRUE, count = 1),
    slices = go_slices(z = go_slices_axis(show = TRUE, locations = c(-0.3, 0.5))),
    caps = go_caps(
      x = go_caps_axis(show = FALSE),
      y = go_caps_axis(show = FALSE),
      z = go_caps_axis(show = FALSE)
    )
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    margin = go_margin(t = 0, l = 0, b = 0),
    scene = go_scene(
      camera = go_scene_camera(eye = go_scene_camera_eye(x = 1.86, y = 0.61, z = 0.98))
    )
  )

fig
```

#### Multiple Isosurfaces with Caps

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/clebsch-cubic.csv")

fig <- df |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_isosurface(
    x = ~x,
    y = ~y,
    z = ~z,
    value = ~value,
    isomin = -10,
    isomax = 10,
    surface = go_isosurface_surface(show = TRUE, count = 4, fill = 0.8, pattern = "odd"),
    caps = go_caps(
      x = go_caps_axis(show = TRUE),
      y = go_caps_axis(show = TRUE),
      z = go_caps_axis(show = TRUE)
    )
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    margin = go_margin(t = 0, l = 0, b = 0),
    scene = go_scene(
      camera = go_scene_camera(eye = go_scene_camera_eye(x = 1.86, y = 0.61, z = 0.98))
    )
  )

fig
```


#### Reference

See `go_isosurface()` for more information and chart attribute options!.
